title: LCLI-792 follow-ups from the round-3 verdict: contended-path rehash, sync-plan test gaps, raw-byte digest
description:
Follow-up from the #746 round-3 APPROVE (verdict recorded verbatim on LCLI-792). Done inside lore's slack; GATES the 0.15.1 bump (LBUMP). Own PR, own reviewer.
- S1 (correctness): set waited = true on every EEXIST/exists outcome BEFORE the snapshot === null branch at src/core/advisory-lock.ts (~:699-710), so a caller whose follow-up read finds the lock gone still rehashes once it owns it. Without it a check computed against a tree a departing sync just rewrote is keyed by the pre-sync hash and a waiter with that pre-sync tree can replay it. A test must go red without the change.
- S2: (a) a beforeDigest: null case: the holder planned a file as absent and the waiter's checkout gains that file during the wait; it must abandon. (b) assert applySyncWritePlan returns true at test/lcli792-advisory-command.test.ts (~:326). (c) assert the lock OWNER, not just existence, inside adopt at test/advisory-lock.test.ts (~:1369).
- N1: hash raw bytes, not decoded text (sync.ts digestOf; the reads decode utf8, so distinct invalid sequences collapse to U+FFFD).
- N2: one doc sentence on applySyncWritePlan: derived plan files (index.md, log.md) can be written stale if a concept is retitled during the wait; the next sync corrects it.
- N3: a throw inside adopt (assertNoSymlinkInAnyPath, non-ENOENT read error) abandons and recomputes, or say why it propagates.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A test red without the S1 change shows a caller that finds the lock vanished after EEXIST rehashes once it owns the lock
The three S2 test gaps are closed, each assertion able to go red
The plan digest hashes raw bytes (N1) and the applySyncWritePlan doc names the derived-file residual (N2)
An adopt throw either abandons and recomputes or the doc says why it propagates (N3)
